scope: Static field semantics for the clientbound battle-result family 0x0139 through 0x013C, from the opcode router through the shared 0x1A0 queue record and its consumer.

fields.name: sequenceId
fields.evidence: FUN_00587210 stores the incremented DAT_01338D2C value.

fields.name: visualResultClass
fields.evidence: Each wrapper stores the selector returned by FUN_00585800.

fields.name: routeFlagOrWrapperArg
fields.evidence: The four router cases pass 1 to their wrappers.

fields.name: effectOrAnimationId
fields.evidence: FUN_00585800 classifies this value and FUN_0058C220 later forwards it to FUN_005785D0.

fields.name: defaultRenderFloat
fields.evidence: FUN_00587210 stores DAT_00F54F70 rather than a wire field; its meaning is unresolved.

fields.name: rowCount
fields.evidence: The row stagers and FUN_0058C220 use this word as the 0x14-byte row-loop bound.

fields.name: headerControlValue
fields.evidence: FUN_0058C220 passes a nonzero value into a distinct header-side render path and then clears it. This disproves the former actionCountHigh label, but does not prove that the value uses the per-row worldMasterTextId namespace.

fields.name: commandId
fields.evidence: Sampled nonzero values join by row ID to the client-data gameCommand family; sheet labels do not prove runtime behavior.

fields.name: presentationFlags
fields.evidence: FUN_00587210 normalizes masked bits and FUN_0058C220 extracts fields; per-bit names remain unresolved.

fields.name: targetRows
fields.evidence: FUN_005874B0 fills as many as 18 rows and FUN_0058EBF0 copies 0x5A dwords from +0x38 through +0x19F; there is no separate opaque tail.

fields.name: numericValue
fields.evidence: Widened from a wire u16 and supplied to the text/render path; damage-only naming is not proven.

fields.name: worldMasterTextId
fields.evidence: Zero rows are skipped; nonzero values join by row ID to client-data worldMaster.csv and feed the text path.

fields.name: rowOrdinalOrFilter
fields.evidence: FUN_0058C220 compares the byte across rows; captured 0x0139/0x013A samples use ordinal values, but the complete semantics are unresolved.

fields.name: reserved
fields.evidence: The X01/X10/X18 row stagers write only offsets +0x00 through +0x0F.

clientDataJoins.commandId: Nonzero retained sample values have matching row IDs in csv/gameCommand.csv and derived/command_battle_params.csv. This proves table identity only, not command behavior, scaling, status application, or final damage computation.
clientDataJoins.worldMasterTextId: Nonzero retained sample values have matching row IDs in csv/worldMaster.csv. The consumer has explicit branches for 0x75B1, 0x75B4, 0x847F, and ranges within 0x848E..0x84A3; localized row text is data evidence, not a complete runtime render mapping.

unresolvedBoundaries: The exact semantics of queue fields +0x14, +0x18, +0x1C, +0x20, +0x24, +0x28, and +0x2C are not named beyond their observed render-context use.
The per-bit names within presentationFlags are not established.
The exact semantics of target-row bytes +0x0E and +0x0F remain incomplete.
0x013B has a complete static shape but no retained retail capture, so runtime row values and the CommandResultX18/BattleActionX18 name discriminator remain unresolved.
